AnalysisNote.description:
A machine-readable, human-readable statement about the analysis itself.

Used for unavailable features, flaw types that were not evaluated, alignment problems, thin baselines,
content mismatch and uncalibrated thresholds, so missing evidence is never silent.
AnalysisNote.title: AnalysisNote

AnalysisStatus.description:
GET /status values.

P0 (synchronous) only ever emits DONE and NOT_FOUND.
PROCESSING and FAILED are reserved for a future asynchronous mode and
are not emitted today.
AnalysisStatus.title: AnalysisStatus

AudioInfo.description:
Participant audio after preprocessing (PreprocessedAudio).

`duration_s` is the duration of the ANALYSED audio (leading/trailing silence removed). Every time in
the result (alignment, feature timelines, pauses, flaws) is expressed in SOURCE time, i.e. on the
timeline of the uploaded recording: `trim_start_s` is the leading silence that was removed before
analysis, and the analysed audio therefore spans [trim_start_s, trim_start_s + duration_s].
AudioInfo.title: AudioInfo

BaselineSummary.description: A usable baseline and the passage it describes (GET /api/v1/baselines).
BaselineSummary.title: BaselineSummary

participant_audio.description: Audio file in WAV or MP3 format
participant_audio.title: Participant Audio

ClarityTimeline.description: P1 acoustic clarity proxy, not an intelligibility score.
ClarityTimeline.title: ClarityTimeline

CustomBaselineResult.description: POST /api/v1/custom/baselines: the baseline that was made from the user's passage and recordings.
CustomBaselineResult.title: CustomBaselineResult

CustomTakeSummary.description: What was measured on one baseline recording of a custom passage (nothing of the audio itself is kept).
CustomTakeSummary.title: CustomTakeSummary

DetectionRule.description:
The rule that flagged a finding, so each flaw states WHY it was flagged.

The finding was flagged where the named normalized signal was `above` (z > threshold_z) or `below`
(z < threshold_z) the threshold for at least `min_duration_s` of flagged time. The thresholds are
initial, uncalibrated values.
DetectionRule.title: DetectionRule

ErrorResponse.description: Body of every non-2xx response (error format).
ErrorResponse.title: ErrorResponse

FeatureName.description: Feature score dimensions. mfcc/clarity are P1.
FeatureName.title: FeatureName

FlawType.description: Flaw categories. The first six are detected; the last two are defined for later detection.
FlawType.title: FlawType

PauseBoundaryType.description: Where in the text a pause occurs.
PauseBoundaryType.title: PauseBoundaryType

UnavailableBaseline.description: A baseline file that exists but cannot be used; `reason` is a short code, never a server path.
UnavailableBaseline.title: UnavailableBaseline

info.description: Track C — Contrastive Speech Analytics & Temporal Flaw Grounding API
info.title: Speech Analytics API

post.description: Accepts participant audio and analysis parameters via multipart/form-data, validates them, and runs the full analysis pipeline synchronously. Returns the structured, evidence-backed AnalysisResult.

400.description: Invalid input, file too large, audio too long or format unsupported

422.description: Validation error in request fields or audio content

post.summary: Analyse a participant recording against a baseline

get.description: Usable baselines with their passage (title, reference text) and whether their statistics are thin; files that exist but cannot be used are listed under `unavailable` with a reason code.

post.description: Accepts the passage text (`passage_text`, optional `title`) and 2 to 6 recordings of a good reading of it (`baseline_audio`, WAV or MP3), aligns each recording to the text, checks that it reads the passage, and stores a baseline under a `custom-…` id. Use that id as `baseline_id` and `passage_id` in `POST /analyze`. Only statistics are stored, never the audio. The same text and recordings give the same id.

422.description: The passage or a recording is not usable

post.summary: Make a baseline from your own passage and recordings

delete.description: Removes a baseline made from a user's own passage and recordings, and its passage text. Project baselines cannot be deleted.

get.description: Returns server status, config version, pipeline version, and API contract version.

404.description: No stored result for this id

get.description: `done` if a valid stored result exists for the id, otherwise `not_found` (HTTP 200 in both cases).
